name: amazon-toolbox
description: 面向跨境电商业务的桌面自动化效率工具箱
author: Amazon Toolbox Team

scripts.build:desktop: set "TOOLBOX_BUILD_TARGET=electron"&& set "TEMP=D:\AmazonToolboxData\build-tmp"&& set "TMP=D:\AmazonToolboxData\build-tmp"&& vite build --mode production
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath build\dist --workpath build\work toolbox-backend.spec && copy /Y build\dist\toolbox-backend.exe ..\electron\toolbox-backend.exe
scripts.electron:build: npm run backend:build && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && set "ELECTRON_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-cache"&& set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-builder-cache"&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.electron:release: npm run release:validate && npm run backend:build && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && set "ELECTRON_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-cache"&& set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=D:\AmazonToolboxData\electron-builder-cache"&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win nsis "-c.publish.url=%ELECTRON_UPDATE_URL%"
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.verify:backend: python -m pytest backend --rootdir=backend -q && python -m ruff check backend/domains/auth backend/domains/knowledge backend/domains/catalog backend/core/deprecation.py backend/app/lifecycle.py backend/routers/auth.py backend/routers/ai_chat.py backend/routers/knowledge.py backend/routers/help.py backend/routers/tools.py backend/routers/announcements.py backend/routers/updates.py && python -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app backend/domains
scripts.verify: npm run security:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run deadcode && npm test && npm run electron:compile && npm run build:desktop && npm run verify:backend

build.productName: 跨境电商赛训效率工具箱
